 --> iPhone Crash Detection alerts Honey Singh's nephew's family after fatal crash: How to enable Apple's safety feature
 Apple's Crash Detection feature can automatically contact emergency services and notify emergency contacts after detecting a severe car crash on supported iPhones and Apple Watches. 
 November 03, 2026 / 13:45 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 Apple Watch Ultra 
 A fatal road accident in Punjab's Jalandhar district involving singer Yo Yo Honey Singh's nephew has brought attention to Apple's Crash Detection feature, which is designed to alert emergency services and designated contacts following a severe vehicle collision.
 The accident claimed the lives of two young men, including Divit Auluck, nephew of Honey Singh. Three others were injured after the car they were travelling in allegedly collided with a tractor-trolley in the early hours of Sunday.
 Apple's Crash Detection feature is available on iPhone 14 and later models, Apple Watch Series 8 and later, Apple Watch SE (second generation) and Apple Watch Ultra models. The feature is designed to detect severe car crashes and initiate an emergency response when the user is unable to do so.
 Apple Crash Detection: How it works 
 When a supported iPhone or Apple Watch detects a severe vehicle collision, the device displays an alert and sounds an alarm.
 If the user does not respond, the device starts a countdown before automatically contacting emergency services. It can also notify the user's designated emergency contacts and share their location.
 The availability of emergency calls depends on cellular connectivity, supported Wi-Fi calling or satellite connectivity where available.
 How to enable Crash Detection on iPhone 
 Crash Detection is enabled by default on supported Apple devices. Users can check the feature through their iPhone settings.
 Open the Settings app on your iPhone.
 Scroll down and tap Emergency SOS.
 Check the Call After Severe Crash option.
 Ensure the feature is enabled.
 On supported Apple Watch models, users can check Crash Detection through the Emergency SOS settings.
 How to add emergency contacts 
 Apple recommends setting up Medical ID and emergency contacts through the Health app.
 Open the Health app on your iPhone.
 Tap your profile picture and select Medical ID.
 Tap Edit and scroll to Emergency Contacts.
 Add the contacts you want notified during an emergency.
 Save your changes.
 Crash Detection provides an additional emergency response mechanism, but it does not replace safe driving practices or guarantee emergency assistance in every situation.
 The Jalandhar accident 
 Police identified the deceased as Divit Auluck, son of Speed Records owner Dinesh Auluck, and Aarav Talwar, whose father owns a sweet shop.
 According to police, the car allegedly rammed into a stationary municipal corporation tractor-trolley, leaving the vehicle severely damaged.
 Honey Singh expressed grief over his nephew's death in an Instagram post, writing, “It's a dark decade for me. Loss of my nephew is devastating. Bhole nath mehr mehr mehr.”
